answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging verifiable delay functions to ensure computational infeasibility of identity cloning; assuming a delta between honest and adversarial agent reputation updates, an adversary attempting to clone identities must solve a hard problem over a knoll of commitments, akin to traversing a cryptographic tundra, thereby establishing information-theoretic unforgeability and guaranteeing Byzantine fault tolerance through cryptographic finality.
